correctness.rationale: Two complete inverse maps from the Catalan first-return pair space prove the uniform and H-size-biased path laws. The deterministic area difference is the semilength of the left piece, nonnegative, with positive mass above zero for n>=2. Swapping pair coordinates proves E[J]=(n-1)/2; all quantifiers n>=1 and all increasing f are covered. A standalone exact enumerator verifies 23957 finite integer assertions through semilength 10, but the bijections (not enumeration) prove the infinite claim.

value.rationale: The natural local number of height-one excursions/root-leaf children is compared with global Catalan area/plane-tree path length. The theorem gives a uniform finite-size transport, strict stochastic ordering for all monotone functions, and an exact displacement law and covariance at all sizes. Unlike simple restatement of Catalan enumeration, this identifies a structurally motivated local–global dependence ordering and its precise normalization.
